proposal.reason: Primary change is in network: proxy progress batching, shutdown/abort socket handling, and proxy op pool sizing, plus NET canConnect behavior. Device-topology is also required because new PATH_NET semantics and ncclTopoCheckNet add topology/affinity-based intra-node NET reachability logic. Transport is additionally needed because P2P and SHM canConnect paths now independently consume that topology decision to disable local transports when NET is preferred.
